context:
Goal: finished chats in other repos are archived too, with nothing lost.
Problem (rule): about 243 sessions belong to other repos (q_max and others). This session's GitHub reads return 403 for them, so the sweep cannot read their PRs. Reading a PR is how the sweep knows a chat is done. Giving the sweep's session read access to each repo is a change to what that session can see, so it needs your word; read access only, no push (your rule: a second repo with push is your word alone).
Based on (read): the consultant's count and options, relayed 23:35 CST; the 403 is the consultant's report, unchecked by triage.
Departs from: main's sweep — it reads only claude-settings; a adds each other repo to the sweep's session with read access and reads the PR; b archives on a title read alone.
Meanwhile: these 243 sessions are kept.
home: plan part 7 (archive sweep); page item 800; step archive-sweep-runs-per-merge
lastAnswer: 816: none of these, "it can skip archiving those" (23:39 CST Nov 13).

options.gain: Each chat is judged by its PR, as in claude-settings; no guessing from titles.
options.label: Add each repo to the sweep's session, read access only, and read each PR (recommended by the consultant)
options.lose: The sweep's session can read those repos; the setup takes one add per repo.

options.label: Archive on a title read alone
options.lose: A chat with live work and a vague title can be archived by mistake.

owner: consultant (session_013NEJKz5AWFJhGvmCUoi6wQ), asked you 23:35 CST; posted by triage (session_013NEJKzCzoWhfP8FMCPtQU6)
reply: Closed. Filed as ruling own-816-skip-other-repo. The sweep keeps the other-repo sessions it cannot read: nothing archived, no read access added, no title-read archiving. I read "skip" as keep; say so if you meant revisit later.
short: Archive 243 other-repo sessions: read their PRs or go by title?
title: About 243 chats are in other repos and their PRs cannot be read. Give the sweep read access to each repo (a), or archive by title alone (b)?
why: Reading those PRs needs read access to each repo, a change only you grant.
